system.description: The dazzling mansion of a powerful noble, lavishly decorated.
system.notes:
Standard | Social

The dazzling mansion of a powerful noble, lavishly decorated.
Impulses: Justify and perpetuate their rule, seduce rivals with promises of power and comfort

Difficulty: 15

Features

All Roads Lead here - Passive: While in the Noble Court, a PC has disadvantage on Charm Rolls made to take actions that don't fit the nobble way of life or support the Noble's dominance.

The Gravity of Nobility - Action: Spend a Fear to present a PC with an offer to satisfy a major goal in exchange for obeying or supporting the noble. The target must make a Charm Reaction Roll. On a failure, they must mark all their Stress or accept the offer. If they have already marked all their Stress, they must reduce their Stress track by the result until after a Rest. On a success, they must mark 1d4 Stress.

Noble Decree - Action: Spend a Fear to tick down a long-term countdown related to the noble's agenda by 1d4. If this triggers the countdown, a proclamation is announced at court when it begins.

Eyes Everywhere - Reaction: On a result with Fear, you can spend a Fear to have someone loyal to the noble overhear the PCs seditious talk. A PC must pass an Instinct Reaction Roll to notice they’re being overheard and intercept the witness before being exposed.
